benchmark_alignment: last ACWI close on a strictly earlier calendar date, at most 5 calendar days old; missing/stale is null; same-date close forbidden across time zones

structure.consolidation: prior20_range_width divided by prior60_range_width; continuous, no cutoff
structure.breakout_context: signal close above prior20 high; descriptive only
structure.pullback_context: signal close relative to prior20 high; continuous
structure.support_resistance: distance to prior20 low/high; no future bars
